supersedes: W2C-PIT-v2.0 for Layer B, Layer C and real F1-F9 only
preserves: exact frozen Layer A evidence blobs and collection method

population.master_population_rule: All 260 rows remain in the master evidence table. No right-censored, unresolved, ambiguous, missing, failed, or inconvenient event is deleted.

right_censoring.definition: semantic_end_utc strictly after frozen_asof_utc before any authoritative revelation/resolution evidence is expected to exist
right_censoring.rule: RIGHT_CENSORED_ASOF is not FAIL and not network missingness. It remains explicit in the full-population table and is excluded only from gate denominators that require an already-due revelation/resolution.

layer_A_reuse.rule: No new platform endpoint, alternate history source, recollection, or post-coverage rescue is allowed in v2.1. Safe-cutoff comparison is performed only against these exact observations.

forbidden: family selection or source routing using subsequent asset performance

missingness.rate_decision: PASS iff lower>=threshold; FAIL iff upper<threshold; otherwise INDETERMINATE
missingness.zero_problem_decision: PASS only with zero confirmed problem and zero unresolved capable of hiding a problem; confirmed problem=FAIL; otherwise INDETERMINATE

safe_cutoff.MINUTE: start of verified authoritative minute minus 1 second
safe_cutoff.DATE_CONSERVATIVE: start of authoritative source-local calendar date minus 1 second
safe_cutoff.rule: Use earliest verified authoritative public timestamp. If credible earlier authoritative release may exist but is unresolved, later evidence cannot silently define a permissive cutoff.

earnings.revelation_rule: earliest verified authoritative public timestamp; issuer date-only evidence uses DATE_CONSERVATIVE rather than assuming the later SEC acceptance time
earnings.resolution_rule: issuer identity, reporting period, EPS metric/basis and reported value must be objectively supported; material source conflict=AMBIGUOUS
earnings.linked_asset_rule: issuer primary U.S.-listed common equity when tradeable; issuer identity cross-checked before outcome/performance use

primary_sources: issuer primary press release or SEC filing describing actual FDA action
fda.revelation_rule: actual FDA action evidence only; PDUFA target/deadline is never decision evidence
fda.negative_action_rule: CRL/non-approval requires auditable FDA public evidence when available or affected issuer primary evidence; otherwise UNRESOLVED/AMBIGUOUS
fda.linked_asset_rule: applicant/sponsor U.S.-listed common equity or clearly documented listed parent; private or ambiguous sponsor mapping does not pass F5

UNITED_STATES: U.S. Census Bureau only for exact Census series
JAPAN: Statistics Bureau of Japan for CPI/labor
CHINA: National Bureau of Statistics of China
INDIA: MoSPI only when the exact official series maps to MoSPI

macro.source_rule: No U.S. fallback for a non-U.S. or unresolved jurisdiction. If the market's exact statistic is proprietary/nonofficial and no authoritative public equivalent matches semantics, do not substitute a nearby series; mark resolution UNRESOLVED or FAIL according to the frozen gate semantics.
macro.release_rule: Use final official release date/time including official rescheduling/revised calendars; stale scheduled dates do not override a documented official revision.
macro.proxy_claim_limit: These U.S.-listed broad-equity ETFs are deterministic feasibility proxies, not claims of maximum event sensitivity. No realized return is read in W2-C.

asset_data.operational_source: project-disclosed Yahoo Finance chart-v8 daily OHLCV source
asset_data.rule: availability only; no return is computed or persisted

gate_denominators.F1: DUE_ASOF only; due unresolved evidence remains denominator as unresolved; RIGHT_CENSORED_ASOF excluded
gate_denominators.F2: DUE_ASOF only; due unresolved evidence remains denominator as unresolved; RIGHT_CENSORED_ASOF excluded
gate_denominators.F3_pit_eligible_and_date_clusters: DUE_ASOF only with lower/upper bounds for unresolved eligibility/revelation date
gate_denominators.F5: FULL_FROZEN_POPULATION because structural linked-asset mapping does not require outcome
gate_denominators.F8: FULL_FROZEN_POPULATION; RIGHT_CENSORED_ASOF is an explicit complete state

pit_event_eligible: For DUE_ASOF events only: confirmed pre-revelation and >=24h Layer A witness under the frozen method, conflict-free mapping, objective non-ambiguous primary resolution, structural linked asset, asset-data availability, safe cutoff, schema complete, and no mandatory account-gated dependency.
scoring_sequence: freeze v2.1 protocol and Layer B/C code
authorize and collect Layer B/C only
if GO, separately preregister and freeze W3 before execution
prohibitions: No Layer A recollection or alternate witness after observed coverage.
No exclusion of right-censored rows from the master population.
No treating right censoring as failure.
No U.S. source or SPY fallback for non-U.S. macro after jurisdiction is known.
No nearby official series substituted for a semantically different proprietary statistic.
No realized linked-asset returns in W2-C.
No F1-F9 execution before combined evidence freeze.
No W3 execution before separate W3 freeze.
freeze_rule: Protocol, jurisdiction router, censoring logic, Layer B/C collectors, combined-evidence builder, F1-F9 scorer and synthetic tests must be byte-frozen before Layer B/C network execution.
